children: QatarEnergy is in advanced ​talks with Venture Global
for a long-term supply deal to buy ​at least 3M metric tons/year of liquefied natural gas, although no further details of a potential agreement are known, Reuters reported Thursday.
QatarEnergy has ​been buying LNG on the spot market from Venture Global
​to supply some of its customers due to the ongoing blockage of the Strait of Hormuz from the U.S.-Iran war.
, top U.S. LNG exporter Cheniere Energy announced a long-term deal to supply QatarEnergy with 4M metric tons/year from 2031 to 2054.

title: Qatar in talks with Venture Global to buy LNG in long-term deal - Reuters
